movie.title: Rao Bahadur
movie.overview: In 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat—labeled a 'man of miracles'—miraculously survives a terminal illness. Plagued by guilt and fear, he retreats into his palatial mansion, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Set in 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat labeled a 'man of miracles' retreats into his grand mansion after surviving a terminal illness, sinking into a surreal world where reality and imagination blur.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat named Rao Bahadur earns the moniker 'man of miracles' after inexplicably recovering from a fatal illness. However, instead of celebrating his recovery, he becomes consumed by deep-seated guilt and existential fear regarding his survival. Retreating within the isolated walls of his palatial mansion, he begins constructing a complex alternate reality. As time passes, the boundaries separating his vivid imagination from true reality begin to terrifyingly erode.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the backdrop of 1970s India, the story follows an eccentric aristocrat whose life changes forever after surviving an ostensibly incurable terminal condition. Known throughout his community as a 'man of miracles', his miraculous recovery brings him neither peace nor clarity. Instead, he is haunted by an overwhelming sense of survivor's guilt and an unnatural fear of the outside world. Seeking refuge from his inner turmoil, he withdraws completely into the vast, labyrinthine halls of his ancestral palatial mansion. Cut off from society, he gradually invents an elaborate alternate world filled with fantastical visions and psychological manifestations. Those around him watch helplessly as his constructed reality threatens to consume his sanity. As eerie occurrences unfold within the grand estate, the line between deliberate illusion and genuine supernatural phenomenon grows increasingly thin. Ultimately, the aristocrat must confront the psychological shadow of his survival before his self-made world claims him forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Rao Bahadur is an atmospheric fantasy-drama thriller set in 1970s India. The story explores the life of an enigmatic aristocrat who becomes widely revered as a 'man of miracles' after defying death and recovering from a fatal condition. Driven by overwhelming guilt and psychological fear, he isolates himself inside his lavish estate, creating a vivid alternate world where fantasy and reality seamlessly collide.

story_structure.climax: His intricate delusions and buried fears reach a breaking point, forcing a ultimate confrontation between his constructed reality and the truth behind his miraculous survival.
story_structure.conflict: Plagued by profound guilt and fear following his recovery, he begins constructing an alternate world within his home, struggling to distinguish genuine reality from his intense imagination.
story_structure.resolution: He reaches a poignant, definitive reconciliation with his mortality, guilt, and the real world outside his mansion walls.
story_structure.introduction: In 1970s India, an eccentric aristocrat known as a 'man of miracles' unexpectedly survives a terminal illness and retreats into his grand palatial mansion.
story_structure.risingAction: As his isolation deepens, the line between his fabricated sanctuary and actual existence collapses, pulling his household and surroundings into an increasingly surreal psychological web.

characters.name: Bhuvanam Ramappa Rao Bahadur
characters.description: An eccentric and terminally ill aristocrat consumed by guilt, paranoia, and obsessive doubts regarding his family bloodline.

characters.name: Dr. Srinivasa Achari
characters.description: Ramappa's long-time friend and physician who attempts to guide him through his psychological struggles and family secrets.

characters.name: Renuka
characters.description: Ramappa's estranged wife who lives in self-imposed isolation while harboring deep-seated secrets about their children.

characters.name: Inspector A. Jagannadhan
characters.description: A law enforcement officer brought in to conduct an official investigation into the family dispute.

characters.name: Achchamma
characters.description: A trusted domestic figure helping maintain the household within the ancestral Bhuvanalayam manor.

characters.name: Lavanappa
characters.description: Ramappa's elder son who bears the emotional weight of his father's mental decline and lineage expectations.

characters.name: Young Kusuma / Lavana (Master Kiran)
characters.description: Portrays one of the young heirs in pivotal flashback sequences depicting early family dynamics.

characters.name: Siddappa
characters.description: A member of the social network surrounding the mansion who interacts with the family.
